leadText: Pocket Monsters HGSS (Japanese: ポケットモンスター HG・SS編) is a shōnen Pokémon manga created by Kosaku Anakubo. It is a sequel to the Pokémon Pocket Monsters, Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire, and manga series and takes place before the manga. The plot follows the adventures of and his Pokémon as they go back to Johto. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.
